# TRL-VAL-0012: IR node shape or enum value is invalid

- Severity: error
- Exit class: error
- Area: VAL
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Use a documented enum and set exactly the payload selected by the node kind.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-VAL-0012", "severity": "error", "params": {}}
```
